statements: create table people(id integer primary key, name text, age integer, email text not null)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 40) insert into people select i, 'resident-' || i, 20 + i % 50, 'r' || i || '@example.test' from c
create table events(ts integer, kind text)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 20) insert into events select 1700000000 + i * 60, 'kind-' || (i % 4) from c
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 5) insert into decoy select 'decoy-' || i from c
create table d_fit(id integer primary key, name text, age integer, email text not null)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 12) insert into d_fit select 100 + i, 'fitted-old-' || i, 30 + i, 'f' || i || '@old.test' from c
create table d_guess(id integer primary key, name text, age integer)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 12) insert into d_guess select 200 + i, 'guessed-old-' || i, 40 + i from c
create table d_none(a integer, b integer, c text, d text, e blob)
with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 12) insert into d_none select 300 + i, i * i, 'none-old-' || i, 'second-' || i, x'cafe' from c
delete from people where id between 10 and 15
